mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.name, s.kind, s.locator, s.branch, s.enabled, s.revision, (#{analyze} AND ()) AS can_analyze FROM c2k_source s WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (#{manage} OR ()) AND POSITION(LOWER(#{keyword}) IN LOWER(s.name)) > 0 ORDER BY s.name, s.id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM c2k_source s WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (#{manage} OR ()) AND POSITION(LOWER(#{keyword}) IN LOWER(s.name)) > 0
SELECT s.id, s.name, s.kind, s.locator, s.branch, s.enabled, s.revision, (#{analyze} AND ()) AS can_analyze FROM c2k_source s WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.id = #{id} AND (#{manage} OR ())
SELECT id, tenant_id, name, kind, locator, branch, enabled, revision FROM c2k_source WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO c2k_source (id, tenant_id, name, kind, locator, branch, enabled) VALUES (#{source.id}, #{source.tenantId}, #{source.name}, #{source.kind}, #{source.locator}, #{source.branch}, #{source.enabled})
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.name, s.description FROM c2k_source_system b JOIN c2k_system s ON s.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND s.id = b.system_id WHERE b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND b.source_id = #{id} ORDER BY s.name, s.id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM c2k_source_system WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND source_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO c2k_source_system (tenant_id, source_id, system_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{id}, #{systemId})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS member_id, a.display_name, g.source_revision, (s.enabled AND g.source_revision = s.revision) AS current FROM c2k_source_grant g JOIN c2k_source s ON s.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND s.id = g.source_id JOIN c2k_account a ON a.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND a.id = g.member_id WHERE g.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND g.source_id = #{id} ORDER BY a.username
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO c2k_source_grant (tenant_id, source_id, member_id, source_revision) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{id}, #{memberId}, #{revision}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, source_id, member_id) DO UPDATE SET source_revision = EXCLUDED.source_revision WHERE c2k_source_grant.source_revision != EXCLUDED.source_revision
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM c2k_source_grant WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND source_id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId}
